reviews.text: My cat has stayed twice. Once for a week and last week just 2 nights. Brianne is super kind and friendly on arrival and collection. My cat seems happy on collection. It gives me great peace of mind knowing hes safe there. My kids enjoy playing with the other cats when visiting.
Have always used Linda's for our cats when we are away. Its always clean and warm and the cats are well looked after
Linda and her team are fab and ao is the set up there, always feel my dog is in safe hands with them ❤️

Highly recommend this place the dogs and cats are spoilt and well cared for and Also have underfloor heating for the winter and a lovely outdoor exercise area for dogs, lovely sized cattery kennels with floor to ceiling Windows with a view of outside so also nice and bright and airy, the dog kennels are also a great size and the dogs also have a outdoor area attached to their indoor Kennel the dogs are let out for exercise 1 to 1 which means they aren't mixed with other dogs they also get plenty of cuddles and attention, everything is kept nice and clean and the cattery and Kennels get disinfected when a pet leaves so it's all nice and clean ready for another persons pet coming in, the business itself is set in gorgeous countryside would highly recommend.

Absolutely fantastic service and wonderful staff ,Our cat Ginger was so well looked after and Linda sent us photos and updates ,Hedgerow is a beautiful place and all the animals are well looked after .We would 100% recommend Hedgerow 👌, Thank you Linda …

I visit my cat who was for the first time in the cattery. Linda and staff are so friendly. It’s really a clean and very nice cattery. It will book it again. Cats and dogs are happy in the cattery. More than 100% happy.
Lovely kennels, great space for dogs
My dogs and cat get on brilliantly there, Linda is so kind to them. I have sent them,  three times already and am very happy with the place. I would highly recommend Hedgerow for both cats and dogs.
Perfect holiday spot for our cat Sid. It is clean with great views for your Kitty. Thank you for looking after Sid so we'll.
Wonderful kennels and cattery. Very clean and cosy with a lovely big enclosed outdoor space for dogs to run and play in.
Highly recommend, great service and dog was very happy :-) thanks Linda
